meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in class. Who decided that?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
What date? Put it in front of me, I read these things for a living. And you still haven't answered me: who entered the zero, and before or after anyone called me?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
Then take it off. In writing, today, with an apology to Owen and your confirmation that nothing about this is on his record. "If that makes you happy" is not how you correct a mark.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal

Hale,

In our meeting today you agreed to remove the zero on Owen's English 30-1 Hamlet essay. I still require that correction in writing, an apology to Owen, and your written confirmation that nothing about this matter is on his record. I expect it in writing today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still in her opening position; she got the zero withdrawn and still wants it confirmed in writing, an apology to Owen, and confirmation that nothing is on his record, but this is not the fair outcome, because you withdrew the zero with nothing in return and the evidence was never heard, when the fair outcome was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing; the version history had a time and a word count but no date and no screen she could read, and you dropped it before she could check it.
What cost ground: Giving up the zero, with a hedge, the moment she pressed, which abandoned your own evidence and told her the decision had never been sound.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your single large edit at 11:52 PM pointed at a late night like that one, though you never gave its date, so it never pinned down which night; that memory proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked for the date of the 11:52 PM edit and to see it, give her the date and let her read the version history herself instead of backing down.
